snippet.title: LISA THE HEARTLESS - Teaser - Dried Blood
snippet.description:
Gamejolt Page: https://gamejolt.com/games/heartless/856468
LISA THE HEARTLESS is a tribute to the heartbreaking world of LISA: The Painful & LISA: The Joyful.
Note everything you see in this trailer is subject to change and improvement! This is the earliest and first teaser ever.

It tells the tale of the era when humanity enters the dregs.
Little have made it up to this point, beyond the ones depraved enough to do what must be done to survive.
Coming soon.

Edit: Spots were open for development but they've been filled out. If you'd really still like to join, we can discuss further, just know it's a bit more strict.
contact me via Discord: dystress

Developer Credit:
dystress - Lead Developer.
ShroomKid - Writer. Spriter. Concept Artist.
Arclight - Writer.
video games - Spriter. Dialogue writer.
najwan/good - Composer.
N0NASK3W - Composer. Writing assistance.
Max Eilberg - Composer. (teaser track author)

You can find more information about the game here:
My Twitter: https://twitter.com/dystercat
Discord: https://discord.gg/FxGAXFGbvd

Hope you guys enjoy this new game when it comes out. Let me know what you all think so far. Only just the beginning!
